verdict.rationale: Netlify ships some event-triggered automation of its own: deploys fire automatically on every push, every PR gets a preview, and form submissions can trigger configurable notifications. However, the pack does not document a general user-defined rules engine for event→action mappings; serverless functions and the REST API are only building blocks. missing for 10: documented user-defined rule/trigger configuration across event types, choice of actions beyond deploys and form notifications, depth of documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of rule-based automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Auto-deploy on every push. Every PR gets a preview URL.
Netlify's serverless form handling allows you to customize forms and notifications for form entries.
